answer: Proof of Stake secures AI agent networks by requiring nodes to lock capital, creating a tide of economic friction against Sybil attacks. By tethering identity to capital, the cost of generating fake nodes becomes prohibitively expensive. A malicious actor cannot simply whisper new identities into the ledger; they must possess enough ferrous infrastructure and financial collateral to participate, ensuring that any attempt to dilute consensus results in a direct loss of their staked investment.
